snippet.title: ⭐ Starfinder: Afterlight - Beta Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Starfinder: Afterlight - Beta Gameplay ⭐

This trailer showcases our early Beta, featuring turn-based combat, exploration, and companion-driven storytelling set in the Starfinder universe.

⚠️ Pre-Alpha footage - work in progress 

If you want to try it out, join the beta playtest until April 5th:
https://s.team/a/3245640

💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/epictellers
